Katy Perry holds the historic distinction of being the first person to reach 100 million followers on Twitter, achieving that milestone in June 2017.
Lady Gaga previously held the #1 spot on the platform with just 5.7 million followers back in August 2010, before Bieber and Obama surpassed her.
